verdict.rationale: Stripe's own docs state that Stripe Tax, its first-party tax product, calculates sales tax, VAT, and GST on invoices, so the core of the story is directly supported. The evidence is a single sentence, though, with no detail on how registrations or jurisdiction rates are managed, or on whether tax is applied automatically to every invoice. missing for 10: documentation of tax registration management, rate/jurisdiction handling, automatic application to every invoice, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates

citations.quote: On an invoice, Stripe Tax calculates sales tax, VAT, and GST.
